title: Cow with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='34' ry='22' fill='#f2f2f2'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='34' ry='22' fill='none' stroke='#c9c9c9' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='26' y='84' width='9' height='12' rx='3' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
  <rect x='44' y='84' width='9' height='12' rx='3' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
  <rect x='60' y='84' width='9' height='12' rx='3' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
  <rect x='75' y='84' width='9' height='12' rx='3' fill='#e0e0e0'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='26' y='93' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b07a4a'/>
  <rect x='44' y='93' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b07a4a'/>
  <rect x='60' y='93' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b07a4a'/>
  <rect x='75' y='93' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b07a4a'/>

  <ellipse cx='35' cy='62' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#8b5e3c'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='72' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#8b5e3c'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='58' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#8b5e3c'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#f7f7f7'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='26' ry='22' fill='none' stroke='#d4d4d4' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='28' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#e8b4b8' transform='rotate(-30 24 28)'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='28' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#e8b4b8' transform='rotate(30 76 28)'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='16' ry='11' fill='#f5c6c6'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='46' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#c97878'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='46' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#c97878'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M45 52 Q50 56 55 52' fill='none' stroke='#c97878' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes white -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='33' r='7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='33' r='7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- eyes dark -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='34' r='4.5' fill='#3a3a5a'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='34' r='4.5' fill='#3a3a5a'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <circle cx='38.5' cy='32' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58.5' cy='32' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='36' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='36' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M41.5 29.5 L42 31 L43.5 31.5 L42 32 L41.5 33.5 L41 32 L39.5 31.5 L41 31 Z' fill='#fff7a8'/>
  <path d='M61.5 29.5 L62 31 L63.5 31.5 L62 32 L61.5 33.5 L61 32 L59.5 31.5 L61 31 Z' fill='#fff7a8'/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <path d='M34 20 Q30 12 36 10' fill='none' stroke='#e8d9a0' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 20 Q70 12 64 10' fill='none' stroke='#e8d9a0' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M83 62 Q90 58 88 68' fill='none' stroke='#d4d4d4' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='69' r='3' fill='#8b5e3c'/>
</svg>
